principle: Research any visitor-interest place where truthful current visual evidence can materially help someone decide whether, when, or how to go. Commercial fit supports prioritization but never bypasses source truth or quality gates.

candidates.provider: Kyoto City / Kyoto City Tourism Association (DMO KYOTO)
candidates.why: Official tourism cameras are explicitly used to show real-time visitor conditions and congestion before/during visits; exceptionally close match to ERN mission.
candidates.next: Resolve durable per-camera URLs, truth type, permission/link-only behavior, currentness and playback.

candidates.why: Official tourism guide identifies live/current views of iconic visitor-interest places; several other listed cameras are currently unavailable and must remain excluded until reverified.
candidates.next: Maintain the two active external live sources and recheck currently unavailable London cameras only after a material provider change.

candidates.provider: Seoul Tourism Organization / Seoul Real-time City Data
candidates.why: Official tourism service already combines real-time crowd, traffic, weather and CCTV links for visitor decision support.
candidates.next: Keep the official Seoul Plaza visual window; retain CCTV links as context/secondary research and review any future camera target independently.

candidates.provider: Tulip Time Festival / City of Holland
candidates.why: Explicit real-time bloom tracking answers the exact See Before You Go question for a seasonal trip.
candidates.next: Recheck feeds before 2027 bloom season; do not promote off-season archival material as current.

candidates.why: Tonami City operates a municipal live-camera network. ERN has already selected one strong Panorama Terrace window as EXTERNAL_LIVE / LINK_ONLY, which satisfies See Before You Go without inferring embed/restream rights.
candidates.next: Maintain the promoted official page as the source of truth. Treat the discovered direct municipal image URL only as optional future LIVE_IMAGE research; do not switch to direct reuse unless permission/currentness behavior is separately approved.

candidates.why: Official local real-time CCTV page is highly relevant geographically, but current page reports feeds as standby/waiting; no public source promotion justified yet.
candidates.next: Recheck only on a material feed-state change. Current official page still reports STANDBY / WAITING FOR FEED; do not promote or simulate a current visual source.

candidates.why: Seasonal farms and orchards embody ERN's origin story, but tourism pages mostly provide static/promotional imagery. This is a future camera-submission/outreach opportunity, not a license to label old media current.
candidates.next: Later use For Places / partner-camera submission to invite farms with real current cameras or frequent current-image feeds.

candidates.why: Visit Finland explicitly curates real-time webcam views so visitors can see what destinations look like right now. This is closely aligned with ERN, but each underlying provider/player and permission path must be reviewed separately.
candidates.next: Maintain Santa Claus Village. Resolve Helsinki Market Square or another Visit Finland target only if it adds distinct visitor value and its provider path is independently verified.

candidates.provider: U.S. National Park Service / Yosemite Conservancy
candidates.why: NPS exposes current Yosemite webcam conditions, but the official page explicitly directs third parties to a Yosemite Conservancy webcam usage agreement before featuring the webcam imagery.
candidates.next: Keep research-only/link-level until a usage agreement is approved or a clearly permitted official external handoff is chosen. Do not reuse current images directly without that permission.

candidates.provider: Société d'Exploitation de la Tour Eiffel (official Eiffel Tower website)
candidates.why: The official Eiffel Tower site exposes live visit conditions such as attendance, opening status, summit temperature/wind and Paris weather. This is useful See Before You Go context but is not a camera or current visual window.
candidates.next: Keep as context-only research. Continue looking for a rights-clear current Paris visual source; never label Eiffel live status data as LIVE_VIDEO/LIVE_IMAGE.
